title: Choose the board composition
question: All three keep the field-book world. Choose the composition to build, or steer a revision.

options.label: Complete cadastral sheet
options.lineage: city plan with full operational margins
options.thesis: The projector sees the whole event as one official plan sheet.
options.viewport: City parcels lead, with squad books left, controls right, and a full event ledger below.
options.risk: The density is excellent on a projector but asks for careful reduction on phones.

options.label: Map-led field book
options.lineage: continuous city plan with narrow working margins
options.thesis: The shared city owns the viewport while squads and phase controls stay at its edges.
options.viewport: A 70% city map, a slim squad gutter, a bottom decision ledger, and a restrained admin margin.
options.risk: The squad work surface must open without shrinking the city into a thumbnail.

options.label: Open field-book spread
options.lineage: city plan on the left, active squad work on the right
options.thesis: The city and the current human decision share one physical spread.
options.viewport: The left page carries all six lots; the right page carries drafts, decision, harness stream, and review.
options.risk: It is ideal for squad work but shows less room-level status at once.
